title: Conduct of hearing
text:
19.39.020 Conduct of hearing.
Any person may appear at the public hearing and submit evidence, either individually or as a representative of an organization. Each person who appears at a public hearing shall state his name, address, and if appearing on behalf of an organization, state the name and mailing address of the organization for the record.
(Ord. 16882 § 2 (part), 2008)
(Ord. No. 17236, § 8, 11-10-2009)
